chunks: And ʿAmr ibn Shimr narrated from Jabir from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام:
Regarding a man who kills his son or his slave, he said: “He is not to be killed for that, but he should be severely beaten and exiled from his place of birth.”

key_terms.لَا يُقْتَلُ بِهِ: Qiṣāṣ is not applied against him for this killing
key_terms.يُضْرَبُ ضَرْبًا شَدِيدًا: He is to be punished with a severe beating

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man kills his son or his slave in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a man who kills his son or his slave. It states that qiṣāṣ is not carried out against him in this case, but that he is to receive a severe beating and be exiled from his hometown as punishment.
